question: By what does Shiva know and act?
premises: divine will exists by mere freedom
that same will is Shiva's instrument
through her, knowing and acting occur
inference: Freedom-will is Shiva's sole organ of knowledge and action.
uncertainties: tviccha read assecond-person will per gloss; tu-particle possible
plain_english: The divine will-power, existing by mere freedom — that same is Shiva's instrument; by her he knows and he acts.
